query: Orders became unavailable right after today's release. Database requests are timing out and capacity looks exhausted.
notes: Paraphrase of the pool-size regression. INC-1022 (too many connections after autoscaling) is a near miss.

query: A number of shoppers were billed two times for a single purchase after our cache cluster switched over to a standby node.
notes: Duplicate charges after a cache failover.

query: Since we swapped the token signing key, roughly one in four people fail to get into their account and logging in feels very sluggish.
notes: Mixed signing keys across replicas.

query: Payment notification callbacks from our card processor are all being refused as tampered ever since we upgraded the HTTP framework.
notes: Webhook signature verification broken by body parsing.

query: Searching the catalog has become painfully slow since the afternoon rollout and the lookup cache never seems to get a hit anymore.
notes: Cache key format change.

query: Our application hosts can no longer write anything because the drive is completely full, and almost all of it is log output.
notes: Verbose logging filled disk.

query: Purchase receipts by email are arriving hours late; the mail sender process keeps dying on one particular item again and again.
notes: Poison message without dead-letter queue.

query: After deploying, the backlog of background tasks keeps climbing because every processor only handles a single task at once.
notes: Concurrency setting silently defaulted. Structurally similar to INC-1042 (a config regression) but different subsystem.

query: Phone apps can't reach our backend anymore since we moved to a different certificate issuer, while desktop browsers are unaffected.
notes: Certificate pinning in mobile apps.

query: Corporate SSO users are bounced with an error saying their identity assertion isn't valid yet, right after we rebuilt the authentication hosts.
notes: Clock drift after image rebuild.

query: When the platform added lots of extra app instances to cope with a traffic surge, the database started turning away new sessions.
notes: Connection explosion from autoscaling. INC-1042 is a near miss.

query: Checkout has been failing for customers since this morning's release; errors appear when they submit their order.
notes: Deliberately ambiguous: three past checkout-after-release outages had different causes (connection pool, expired dependency certificate, payment provider outage). Any is a valid retrieval; the recommendation should not assert a single cause.

query: People say the web API feels sluggish; response times roughly doubled, and bouncing the service only helps for a little while.
notes: Temporary relief after restart suggests memory pressure (INC-1015); periodic spikes (INC-1031) is also plausible.

query: Customers keep getting kicked out of their accounts at random and have to sign back in, and our shared in-memory store is maxed out.
notes: Session eviction from shared Redis.

query: Visitors from Southeast Asia see very slow page loads and pictures since we changed who hosts our domain name records.
notes: Missing geo-routing after DNS migration. INC-1048 (DNS provider outage) is a near miss.

query: The overnight billing run never kicked off; the scheduler claims some other instance already owns the task, but nothing is running it.
notes: Stale distributed lock.

query: The office printer on the third floor keeps jamming and printing blank pages.
notes: No relevant experience exists.

query: Our latest social media campaign received far fewer likes than the marketing team expected.
notes: Business question, not an incident.

query: The data science team's recommendation model scores lower accuracy this month than last month.
notes: Technical but no comparable incident in memory; must not be forced onto a latency or deployment incident.
